methods.bounded_passing_witness: A bounded projection of the same deterministic execution exposes all acceptance scalars without truncation or replaying a canonical validation.
methods.candidate_workaround: Project only surface count, outcome counts, mutation counts, runner count, network calls, and validity for console diagnostics while preserving the full in-memory payload for committed artifacts.
methods.failure_signature: The first all-surface engine smoke run succeeded but its full nested JSON exceeded the console output bound, so the display received no complete-read credit.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never print the complete nested twenty-surface execution payload during interactive diagnostics.
methods.rollback: The diagnostic wrote no file, changed no Git state, contacted no service, and earned no validation credit.

methods.bounded_passing_witness: The same bounded file was audited with supported simple patterns and exposed only the intended immutable predecessor path.
methods.candidate_workaround: Use literal or simple alternation searches for this audit, reserving the explicit PCRE2 mode for cases that genuinely require look-around.
methods.failure_signature: A combined ripgrep audit used a negative look-ahead that the default regex engine rejects.
methods.recurrence_guard: Do not use look-around with ripgrep unless the command explicitly selects the PCRE2 engine.
methods.rollback: The failed search was read-only, wrote no artifact, staged nothing, and changed no repository or external state.

methods.bounded_passing_witness: Bounded line windows and symbol searches expose the complete relevant test contract without another oversized display.
methods.candidate_workaround: Inspect the test module with bounded line windows and exact symbol searches, then make only small attributable edits to the owner-local copy.
methods.failure_signature: An attempt to display the complete predecessor test module in one tool response exceeded the context output bound and therefore earned no complete-read credit.
methods.recurrence_guard: Measure source length first and split any nontrivial test-module inspection into bounded windows.
methods.rollback: The failed display was read-only, created no file, staged nothing, and changed no repository or external state.

methods.bounded_passing_witness: The replacement searches returned the complete function, alias, registry, and surface declaration locations.
methods.candidate_workaround: Use two simple single-quoted ripgrep searches for symbol declarations and literal surface keys.
methods.failure_signature: A composite ripgrep expression used to inspect engine symbols had an unclosed group after shell quoting and was rejected before reading the file.
methods.recurrence_guard: Prefer small literal searches over shell-sensitive composite expressions for source inventory.
methods.rollback: The rejected search was read-only, produced no credited evidence, and changed no file, index, Git ref, or external state.

methods.recurrence_guard: Do not pass unexpanded Windows wildcard path arguments to ripgrep; use exact directories, rg globs, or materialized literal path arrays.
methods.rollback: The rejected audit was read-only, created no file, staged nothing, and changed no repository or external state.

methods.recurrence_guard: Inspect the committed Method Flow schema before asserting optional convenience fields in lifecycle tests.
methods.rollback: The failed test was read-only; it changed no artifact, index, Git ref, remote, or external system and earned zero passing credit.

methods.bounded_passing_witness: An isolated four-manifest replay validated 312 exact entries with zero blob mismatches while reporting ten legacy noncanonical worktree metadata rows.
methods.candidate_workaround: Retain the failed aggregate, make exact Git blob identity the canonical content domain, report noncanonical worktree byte metadata separately, and target any later aggregate only at an additive corrected final.
methods.failure_signature: The one canonical aggregate at the retained initial final passed 63 tests, 140 JSON parses, and privacy/security scans, but failed manifest replay because legacy prospective byte and SHA fields described mixed Windows worktree materialization rather than canonical Git blob bytes.
methods.recurrence_guard: Build future manifests from staged or committed Git blob bytes; never treat mutable worktree line endings as the canonical content domain.
methods.rollback: The failed external receipt remains immutable at zero success credit; the retained initial final remains ancestral and is not rewritten.

methods.bounded_passing_witness: The original process was uniquely identified and allowed to exit without duplicate execution; the later bounded replay surfaced and reused its continuation handle correctly.
methods.candidate_workaround: Inspect the exact process read-only, wait for that process to exit, and surface full execution-result metadata for any replacement probe.
methods.failure_signature: The first isolated replay probe crossed its observation window while the wrapper projected stdout only, suppressing the continuation handle; the invocation therefore earned zero passing credit.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never project only stdout for a command that can return a continuation session; preserve the full result envelope until terminal exit.
methods.rollback: The probe was read-only, changed no file or ref, and its unseen output received zero validation credit.

methods.bounded_passing_witness: The replacement probe used byte values, preserved exact blob identity, and correctly exposed that uniform CRLF expansion was not the historical byte domain.
methods.candidate_workaround: Construct byte separators from integer values to remove shell-escape ambiguity.
methods.failure_signature: A seven-path recovery probe over-escaped CR/LF byte literals through the shell, so it searched for backslash characters and earned zero compatibility credit.
methods.recurrence_guard: Use byte-value construction or a checked script file for nested-shell binary literal probes.
methods.rollback: The malformed probe was read-only and changed no repository or external state.

methods.bounded_passing_witness: The exact four-manifest component replay passed all 312 entries with canonical Git blob identity and explicitly reported ten noncanonical metadata rows.
methods.candidate_workaround: Refuse to reconstruct noncanonical worktree bytes; validate exact Git blob identity and surface legacy byte metadata only as noncanonical compatibility information.
methods.failure_signature: A correctly escaped seven-path probe showed that whole-file LF-to-CRLF expansion did not reproduce the legacy manifest metadata because the edited Python files had mixed line-ending materialization.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never infer a uniform checkout line-ending transform for files produced by mixed copy and patch operations.
methods.rollback: The rejected assumption changed no files or refs and conferred no manifest or aggregate success credit.
